verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a concrete CSV-based Product Catalog Import API (v2.commerce.product_catalog.imports) with presigned upload URLs, daily product cadence and 15-min inventory/pricing refresh, explicit replace-mode deletion semantics, per-row error reporting via webhooks, and restricted-key permissions for the import endpoint — this is a documented feed/import mechanism that publishes a merchant's catalog into agent surfaces (ChatGPT via ACP, embedded AI interfaces via ACS). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on merchant confirmation that the import pipeline works at scale in production, and clearer detail on how catalog data syncs into specific third-party agent surfaces beyond Stripe's own docs.
